name: Rigging Crawler
flavor: A thing of knotted rope and pulley-wheels that lives in the roof of the tent and comes down head first.
acNote: rope, and hard to get a clean line on

attacks.name: Hooked Bite
attacks.note: The target makes a DC 11 Constitution save or takes 1d4 poison damage as well.

features.name: Down the Wire
features.description: It moves along rigging, guy ropes and tent poles as easily as along the ground, and opportunity attacks against it have disadvantage while it is on one.

tactics: It drops, bites, and goes back up. It should almost never be standing on the sand at the end of its turn — a Crawler that fights toe to toe is a Crawler about to die, which is the point: the party has to find a way to bring it down.
narration: Something in the dark above you takes up the slack in a rope, hand over hand over hand, and then there is no rope left to take.
